original_request: تطوير نظام ذكي لاكتشاف الأكواد الجغرافية وإعادة استخدامها داخل GIS-Development-Skills
assumptions: المهارة الجديدة هي gis-code-discovery وترتبط بالموجه العام دون إنشاء نظام توجيه مواز
المصادر المعتمدة الأولية الـ 12 هي نقطة انطلاق وليست قائمة مغلقة
تحديث العداد من 34 إلى 35 مهارة في جميع ملفات المستودع والمانيفست
goal: Build an intelligent GIS code discovery and reuse specialist with verified source registries, semantic recipe catalog, and Main Router integration
desired_outcomes: A structured, extensible registry of vetted GIS code repositories and official cookbooks
A function-level semantic recipe database supporting discovered, reviewed, adapted, and tested states
A deterministic discovery and scoring engine that validates functional fit, SDK/API version, license, and spatial fidelity
Clean integration into the GIS Development Router and bilingual documentation
success_criteria: The new specialist skill passes validate_skill_pack.py and security audit
The 10 practical verification test scenarios pass with 100% in tests/test_code_discovery.py
Repository manifest, READMEs, index.html counters, and intent router are synchronized to 35 skills
DoneProof report verifies completion against reviewed criteria

tasks.title: Build GIS code source and recipe registries
tasks.description: Create references/gis-code-sources.json containing the 12 vetted primary sources with license, version and capability metadata, and references/gis-code-recipes.json supporting recipe states.
acceptance_criteria: gis-code-sources.json indexes the 12 vetted repositories with explicit license and supported version metadata
gis-code-recipes.json supports discovered, reviewed, adapted, tested, rejected, and deprecated states

tasks.title: Author the gis-code-discovery specialist skill and cross-agent adapters
tasks.description: Create skills/gis-code-discovery/SKILL.md adhering to Agent Skills spec with 10-step lifecycle, and create OpenAI, Cursor, and Claude adapters.
acceptance_criteria: SKILL.md frontmatter description is under 1024 characters and documents the discover-evaluate-adapt-test workflow
Cross-agent adapters are provided for Cursor, Claude, and OpenAI

tasks.title: Implement the function-level code discovery and evaluation engine
tasks.description: Create scripts/gis_code_discovery.py to parse natural language requests into GIS concepts, search repositories and recipes, and score candidate solutions against technical and spatial criteria.
acceptance_criteria: gis_code_discovery.py maps queries to GIS concepts (e.g. raster sampling, ribbon commands, PyQGIS algorithms)
Engine scores candidates across functional fit, SDK version, license permissions, and spatial fidelity

tasks.title: Integrate with Main Router, update manifest and bilingual documentation
tasks.description: Register gis-code-discovery in skills/gis-development/SKILL.md, scripts/intent_router.py, update manifest to 35 skills, and synchronize README.md, README.ar.md, and index.html.
acceptance_criteria: Main GIS router and intent router recognize code discovery requests in English and Arabic
Repository manifest and index.html agree on 35 discoverable skills

tasks.title: Implement practical 10-scenario test suite and verify completion
tasks.description: Create tests/test_code_discovery.py covering ArcGIS Pro SDK vs ArcPy, PyQGIS algorithms, GDAL raster sampling, WebGIS, KML styles, license refusal, and run full verification suite.
acceptance_criteria: All 10 practical verification test scenarios pass in tests/test_code_discovery.py
Full repository validation suite passes cleanly with zero blocking findings
DoneProof report verifies completion against reviewed criteria
